text: Strudel Studio 是 DeepDeck 的浏览器音乐编程工作区：它在侧边栏提供 Strudel REPL，用户可编写并试听 Strudel pattern，浏览示例、声音和语法参考，也能复制、下载或打开分享源码。AI 助手可根据当前源码、选中片段和可选图片回答问题或提出完整修改草稿；草稿会回到编辑器，用户自行试听。运行时使用官方 Strudel REPL。安装需要 DeepDeck 的 Apps、App Conversations、附件和工具运行时；代码未声明额外 API 密钥。播放时可能需要联网加载上游声音清单，打开分享链接会将源码放入 Strudel 分享地址。

Strudel Studio is a DeepDeck REPL for writing and playing Strudel patterns. Browse examples and references, then copy or download source. Ask the main Agent about a draft and review suggested rewrites. Playback may fetch upstream sound manifests; sharing opens a Strudel URL containing the source.
想在 DeepDeck 里直接写代码编曲并试听节奏。
有没有能用 AI 解释或改写当前 Strudel 音乐草稿的工作区？
I want to browse music pattern examples, edit one, and export the source code.
Strudel Studio 的功能「编写并试听音乐 pattern」：编辑器提供 Strudel REPL 与示例，用户载入示例或输入源码后按播放或更新来试听，也可打开声音和语法参考。
Strudel Studio 的功能「AI 辅助改写」：用户可向 DeepDeck 主 Agent 发送当前源码、指令、选区和可选图片；Agent 返回的完整草稿更新编辑器，用户可检查后自行播放。
Strudel Studio 使用上游声音清单与媒体来源；代码允许访问 raw.githubusercontent.com、gleitz.github.io 和 felixroos.github.io，首次播放可能需要联网。
点击分享会在 strudel.cc 打开包含当前源码编码的分享链接；分享行为会把这份源码带到 Strudel 页面。

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · Strudel Studio for DeepDeck：A source-backed DeepDeck App that brings the official [Strudel](https://strudel.cc/) browser REPL into a Strudel.cc-style workspace and adds a revision-safe AI Assistant through DeepDeck App Conversations.

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · Screenshot：The standalone Strudel Studio workspace combines the official live-coding editor and transport with DeepDeck-native examples, sound browsing, reference, export, console, settings and AI-assisted composition. The screenshot uses the bundled starter pattern and contains no account or personal data.

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · Install with DeepDeck (recommended)：Install [DeepDeck](https://github.com/jo32/DeepDeck) first, then:

1. Open **Settings → Apps** in DeepDeck.
2. Paste `https://github.com/jo32/dsh-strudel-studio.git` into **Install an App plugin**.
3. Choose **Inspect source**, review the detected package and build command, then choose **Confirm install**.
4. Restart DeepDeck when prompted.
5. Open **Apps → Strudel Studio** from the sidebar.

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · Install with DeepDeck (recommended)：For local development, build the checkout and install the resulting local bundle into the active DeepDeck web profile:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jo32/dsh-strudel-studio.git
cd dsh-strudel-studio
bun install
bun test

The last command mounts the Cordis App bundle. Run it in a DeepDeck-managed profile so the required Apps and App Conversations runtimes are available.

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · What changed：The former visual step-sequencer builder and its simulated audio engine have been removed. The App now uses the published upstream runtime directly:

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · What changed：- `@strudel/repl@1.3.0` for CodeMirror, Strudel evaluation, scheduling, highlighting, samples and Web Audio
- `@strudel/core@1.2.6` for compatible Strudel source sharing
- a shell modeled on the upstream Strudel REPL: 40px transport header, full-height editor, right-side menu tabs, examples, sounds, reference, export, console and settings
- a new **AI Assistant** tab connected to the canonical DeepDeck main-Agent Session
@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · What changed：The package identity remains `@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder` and the App ID remains `strudel-vis-builder`.

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · AI Assistant contract：The standalone App sends a bounded instruction, the complete current Strudel source, a non-negative revision, and up to four optional pasted images through a fixed `message` action. The bottom-pinned composer supports paste, picker, drag-and-drop, previews, and removal. Users can also select an exact CodeMirror range and right-click to attach it to the composer or trigger a focused Agent rewrite. Questions receive normal Agent replies. Explicit change requests may call one App-owned tool:

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · AI Assistant contract：Pasted images are validated on both runtime and Host boundaries (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, at most four, 5 MiB each and 12 MiB total), stored through the Harness attachment service, and exposed to the Agent only through expiring opaque tokens and `strudel_view_image`. Returned drafts are rejected when stale, oversized, malformed or when they contain browser, DOM, network, storage, navigation, import, cross-window messaging or dynamic-evaluation APIs. A successful draft replaces CodeMirror content but **never starts playback automatically**. The user reviews the code and explicitly presses play/update.

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · Runtime isolation：Strudel’s official evaluator intentionally uses dynamic JavaScript evaluation. To keep that capability away from the trusted DeepDeck bridge:

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · Runtime isolation：1. The App window is a same-origin bridge page with a CSP that does not permit `unsafe-eval`.
2. The Strudel UI runs inside an iframe with `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-downloads allow-popups"` and no `allow-same-origin`.
3. The child frame therefore has an opaque origin and cannot read the bridge page, DeepDeck local storage or same-origin Host APIs.
4. A private `MessageChannel` carries bounded source and Agent state between the two surfaces.
5. Only the sandboxed runtime CSP allows `unsafe-eval`, remote sample reads and blob workers.

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · Runtime isolation：User-authored Strudel still executes as JavaScript inside that sandbox after an explicit play/update action. The default upstream sample manifests are loaded from `raw.githubusercontent.com`, so first playback may require network access.

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · Development：```bash
bun install
bun test
bun run build
```

When editing this registered DeepDeck App Workspace, use the Creator apply lifecycle instead of invoking the build separately. Generated `lib/` output is build-only.

@deepdeck-apps/strudel-vis-builder README · Architecture：| Area | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Cordis Host registration, CSP routes and action tool | `src/index.js` |
| DeepDeck launcher and main-Agent action | `src/client.js` |
| Trusted App-window bridge and revision owner | `src/app.js` |
| Opaque-origin official Strudel runtime and UI | `src/runtime.js` |
| Source, AI validation and starter pattern | `src/studio-model.js` |
| Agent prompt contract | `src/agent-actions.js` |
| Agent Session continuation routing | `src/agent-continuation.js` |
| Standalone UI styling | `src/app.css` |
